learning_outcomes.text: To study and to know the fundamentals of discretization of methods applied to finite differences, finite volumes and finite elements.
To provide the ability to choose a numerical resolution strategy adapted to the problem.

syllabus_topics: Properties of methods and solving model problems
Numerical resolution of one or several PDEs using finite differences, finite volumes or finite elements methods
bibliography: R. Petit L’outil mathématique pour la physique Dunod, 1998.
C. Hirsch, Numerical computation of internal and external flows. Vol. 1: Fundamentals of numerical discretization, Wiley. 1999
B. Mohammadi, J.H. Saia. Pratique de la simulation numérique. Dunod, 2003.
JP Nougier, Méthodes de calcul numérique, Masson
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
